scope: Independent read-only AST and source review of isolated SAM body override extension; no model, fixture, Git or runtime invocation

admission_review.override_review: requires visible/reviewed row, exact declared source, root_engineering_reviewed true, nonempty review_note
admission_review.receipt_binding: requires matching scene, completed returncode0, cached SAM vit_h, no GT boxes, no DEVA modification, amp false, existing recorded checkpoint/source/interpreter
admission_review.candidate_binding: requires exactly one matching frame, no GT prompt, exact candidate index/path match, uint8 expected-shape binary0/255 nonempty image with recorded candidate area
admission_review.body_consistency: preflight resolves each body, rejects pixel overlap against per-frame resolved_union and accumulates the union before returning; build and validate both use resolved_body; nooverride remains np.isin(original DEVA IDs)
admission_review.geometry: original projection, nearest2x2 visibility plus0.5m depth, connected component0.5m, dominant component minimum half, raw pose world transform and temporal PLY fields unchanged
admission_review.static: existing static PLY still required; no static regeneration or static exclusion algorithm changed in this adapter; actual original strict0.1m loader validation remains pending
admission_review.training_ready: all check/build/validate result literals retain false

parent_reported_visual_review.provenance: root task message, not independently repeated by this reviewer

findings.title: Default check does not reject overlapping resolved SAM actor bodies
findings.trigger: Multiple actors have disjoint original DEVA IDs but their admitted SAM overrides or a SAM and DEVA body overlap in pixels
findings.actual: preflight validates ID disjointness and calls resolved_body without accumulating the returned masks; check may return READY_ACTOR_CPU_PLAN. build rejects overlap only after creating output directories and possibly earlier-frame outputs
findings.impact: Incorrect plan admission and avoidable partial output; actual build/validate still fail before training readiness. Current single-actor red plan is unaffected
findings.suggested_fix: Within each preflight frame, accumulate resolved body union and require no union/body overlap before returning the plan
findings.verification: source path analysis only; no new mirrored test or fixture

resolution.change: preflight initializes resolved_union per frame, requires not np.any(resolved_union & body), then accumulates resolved_union |= body
resolution.ordering: build calls preflight before output root mkdir; default check calls the same preflight
resolution.verification: current source and AST inspected only; no new fixture or runtime test
